answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 12800 Country: India Title: Mufti sab assalamu alaikum. Ky islam me pepsi, coco cola, thums up pine aur bechne ki ijajat hai Question: Mufti sab assalamu alaikum. Ky islam me pepsi, coco cola, thums up pine aur bechne ki ijajat hai Answer ID: 12800 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1145/883=H/1430) If it is neither containing any impure thing nor there is any other reason, it is lawful to drink, sell and purchase the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
